gaps.sentence: I should ___ writing down the telephone number.
gaps.hint: make a point of doing = be sure to do

gaps.lead: I think learning to use a typewriter is a waste of time.

gaps.explanation: 'A waste of time' becomes 'can't see the point in/of doing it'.

gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle expresses regret about a past action.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
